significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling and ordering: a capability appears when "task-relevant linear features becomes disentangled," with the geometric transition preceding or coinciding with the behavioral jump, plus a form-(ii) mechanism whereby ablating those features selectively removes the skill. This fixes expectations for capability trajectories at later checkpoints, links smooth geometric change to discontinuous accuracy, and predicts a selective causal consequence rather than merely asserting that capability information is represented. The conclusion directly bears on the live interpretation represented by Wei et al. (2022) and Schaeffer et al. (2023); a negative result would rule out this particular disentanglement account across the named tasks, although it would not by itself decide whether all apparent emergence is artifactual, and the two branches are distinguishable despite some looseness in "disentangled" and "precedes or coincides." The claim establishes both a cross-training phenomenon and an internal causal mechanism; after topic substitution, the generic relationship between language and intelligence would not support this score, because the extra weight comes specifically from the asserted geometry-behavior ordering and selective-ablation consequence.

reach.justification: The named handle is the "continuous geometric measure" of feature separability, effective dimensionality, and monosemanticity, proposed as an "early-warning signal for capability onset," together with the disentangled feature directions as intervention targets. It is potentially ex ante when the geometric transition precedes behavior, although the alternative wording "or coincides with" does not guarantee an action window in every case. After per-model re-extraction, the substantive ordering and predictive coupling still forecast what should occur across checkpoints, so more than a mere search procedure transfers; however, the asserted evidence domain is principally language-model training and the listed capability class, not arbitrary architectures or modalities. Model developers and capability auditors could use the signal to monitor or gate training runs, and topic substitution would not preserve this reach because the generic language-intelligence topic supplies neither this predictor nor its lead-time relation.
